data.standardized_narrative: No clear gross prior-year reserve movement or opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) could be confidently extracted from the scanned report images provided. The PDF appears to be image-scanned and many numeric tables and notes (Balance Sheet technical provisions, Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, and the claims development triangle) are not reliably OCR'd here. Gross written premium is visible and extracted; reserve movements and technical provisions require higher-resolution OCR or original digital text to extract GROSS (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement.
data.data_quality_notes: The report was provided as scanned images with low legibility for liability and technical reserves notes. I was able to read the total gross premiums written (291,210 USD'000  291.21 in millions) from the Income Statement, but I could not confidently locate or read the Balance Sheet line 'Gross claims outstanding' for the prior-year comparative column nor a clear 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure. No reliable gross claims development triangle or gross prior-year movement could be extracted. All reserve-related fields are therefore null. Recommend supplying higher-resolution scans or the original PDF/text for accurate extraction of GROSS reserve balances and prior-year development.
